CHIEF COMPLAINT
Yearly exam.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Beverly is a 24-year-old female with a history of type 2 diabetes and hypertension presenting for her yearly exam. She reports that she has been doing well overall but began working in a bakery this summer. She notes that her proximity to desserts and treats at work has led to increased snacking and consumption of sweets during her shifts. She reports her blood sugars have been up and down, which she attributes to her diet changes. She has been compliant with her diabetes medication. She denies missing doses of medication. Regarding her hypertension, she reports her blood pressure has been good despite the fluctuations in her diabetes control.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient denies any additional concerns. She reports sleeping well, getting a full eight hours of sleep. She denies any concerns about harming herself. Otherwise, review of systems is unchanged from baseline.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Type 2 diabetes mellitus
Hypertension
Systolic ejection murmur (grade 2, unchanged)

MEDICATIONS
Metformin 500 mg twice daily
Lisinopril 10 mg once daily

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient recently started working in a bakery this summer, which she enjoys. She has been experiencing difficulty resisting temptation from desserts and treats at work, leading to increased dietary indiscretion.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
General: Alert and oriented. Strength: 5/5 bilateral upper and lower extremities. Sensation: Intact to light touch bilaterally. Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm. Grade 2 systolic ejection murmur present, unchanged from prior exams. No carotid bruits. Pulses good bilaterally. Respiratory: Lungs clear bilaterally. Neurological: Grips equal bilaterally. Neurovascular: Intact. Extremities: No edema. No thyromegaly noted.

RESULTS
Hemoglobin A1c: Elevated
Blood pressure: Normal
Vital signs: Stable

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus - Out of control. Patient counseled on dietary modification, specifically to reduce snacking and consumption of additional sweets. Instructed to check fasting blood sugars in the morning and call in results in two weeks. Will recheck in two months. Goal hemoglobin A1c is under 7%, preferably under 6%. No medication changes at this time; will consider adding additional medication if dietary modifications do not improve control. Continue metformin 500 mg twice daily.

2. Hypertension - Stable on current regimen. Continue lisinopril 10 mg once daily. No changes at this time.
